headline: Natalia Shuman Joins Mettler Toledo Board of Directors
summary: COLUMBUS, Ohio, August 03, 2026--Mettler-Toledo International Inc. (NYSE: MTD) announced today that Natalia Shuman has been appointed to its Board of Directors effective August 3, 2026.
